Severity is observed market stress magnitude, not news importance. indexImpact true only for direct, bounded evidence in the named market/driver. Otherwise false. Never adjust a score to make it move. Provide direct source URLs actually retrieved, not aggregator links or invented references. An accepted fact must be directly supported by the primary source.
